title: CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables
chineseTitle: 第 4 章：绿山墙的清晨

paragraphs.en: Morning at Green Gables
paragraphs.zh: 绿山墙清晨的一幕

paragraphs.en: Anne awoke to bright sunlight streaming through the window. Confused for a moment, she remembered Green Gables and felt a mix of joy and dread. She sprang out of bed and pushed up the stiff, creaking sash.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮从窗户透进来的明媚阳光中醒来，一时有些迷茫，但很快想起了绿山墙农庄，心中交织着喜悦和一丝担忧。她一跃而起，用力推开了那扇老旧吱吱作响的窗子。

paragraphs.en: Outside, a cherry tree in full bloom greeted her. Anne knelt by the window, gazing at the June morning with delight. The tree's boughs tapped against the house, heavy with blossoms.
paragraphs.zh: 外面，一棵盛开的樱桃树迎接了她。安妮跪在窗前，欣喜地凝望着六月的晨光。树枝轻轻敲打着房子，满是花簇。

paragraphs.en: On both sides, orchards filled with apple and cherry trees were also in bloom. Dandelions dotted the grass.
paragraphs.zh: 两边的草地上点缀着苹果树和樱桃树，眼下正盛开。蒲公英在其中散落开来。

paragraphs.en: Below, lilac trees purple with flowers perfumed the air. Beyond the garden, a clover field sloped down to a brook surrounded by birches. A hill, green with spruce and fir, rose beyond, with a glimpse of sea on the horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 下面，紫罗兰树散发着花香，将紫色的芬芳洒满了空气。花园外，一片紫花苜蓿田蜿蜒至一条溪流旁，四周是白桦树。更远处，有一座覆盖着云杉和冷杉的绿色小山，海平面在地平线上隐隐可见。

paragraphs.en: Anne's eyes took in every detail, her beauty-loving nature savoring the scene. She had seen many unlovely places, but this was breathtakingly lovely.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的眼睛捕捉到了每一个细节，她那爱美的心性尽情品味着眼前的美景。尽管她见过不少不那么动人的地方，但这里却美得令人心旷神怡。

paragraphs.en: Anne stood up, taking a deep breath. "Isn't it wonderful?" she exclaimed, gesturing at the beautiful world outside.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮深吸了一口气，站了起来。“多美好的一天啊！”她脱口而出，一边朝窗外那美丽的景色比划着。

paragraphs.en: Marilla entered silently and said, "It's time to get dressed."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉悄声说道：“该起床穿衣服了。”

paragraphs.en: The girl continued her reverie. "I meant everything—the garden, orchard, brook, woods—radiant with life," she said. "Don’t you feel like loving the whole world on such a morning?
paragraphs.zh: 女孩陷入了沉思：“我说的都是真心话——花园、果园、溪流、树林——都充满了生机。”她说道，“这样的早晨，你不觉得应该爱整个世界吗？”

paragraphs.en: I can hear the brook laughing up here. Even in winter, it’s always cheerful, under the ice too."
paragraphs.zh: 我听见小溪在这里欢快地流淌。即使在冬天，它也总是在冰下欢笑着。

paragraphs.en: Marilla interrupted, urging Anne to get ready for breakfast. "You'd better dress and come downstairs. Wash your face and comb your hair.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉打断了她，催促安妮赶紧准备吃早餐：“你最好快点穿好衣服下楼去。记得洗洗脸，梳梳头。”

paragraphs.en: Leave the window open and turn back your bedclothes."
paragraphs.zh: 打开窗户，把被子掀开。

paragraphs.en: Anne appeared well-prepared when she descended the stairs, dressed neatly, her hair tidy, face clean, and a sense of accomplishment in her demeanor. She sat down at the table where Marilla had placed a chair for her and remarked, "I'm quite hungry this morning. The world seems less daunting today.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮下楼时显得准备充分，穿着整齐，头发梳理得整整齐齐，脸上干干净净，举止间透着一股成就感。她坐在玛丽拉为她准备的椅子上，说道：“今天早上我饿得很呢。感觉今天的世事没那么让人畏惧了。”

paragraphs.en: I’m glad it’s sunny, but rainy mornings are enjoyable too. Each day brings its own surprises, don’t you think? It's easier to be cheerful on a sunny day."
paragraphs.zh: 天气晴朗当然好，不过雨天早晨也别有一番风味。每一天都会有不同的惊喜，不是吗？晴天更容易让人高兴些。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla interrupted sharply, "For pity's sake, hold your tongue. You talk far too much for a little girl."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉尖刻地打断道：“天哪，别再说了。你这个小女孩儿话可真多。”

paragraphs.en: Anne obediently remained silent throughout the meal, which was unusually quiet. Matthew also kept his silence, making the meal even more tense. As they ate, Anne’s eyes fixed on the sky outside, her mind elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮默默地在整个餐桌上保持沉默，这顿饭异常安静。马修也一言不发，使得气氛更加紧张。吃饭的时候，她的目光停留在窗外的天空上，心思却早已飘到了别处。

paragraphs.en: Marilla grew increasingly uneasy, fearing that Anne's spirit had wandered far away in some distant cloudland.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉越来越不安，担心安妮的精神已经飘得很远，或许是在某个遥远的云端世界。

paragraphs.en: Marilla wondered who would want such a child around. Despite this, Matthew wished to keep her, much as he did the night before. He clung to his whim with unwavering persistence, a trait that made Marilla even more nervous.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉纳闷到底谁会要这样一个孩子。尽管如此，马修还是想留下她，就像前一晚那样坚决。他坚持自己的念头，这种固执让玛丽拉更加不安。

paragraphs.en: After finishing their meal, Anne offered to wash the dishes, but Marilla skeptically asked if she could do it properly.
paragraphs.zh: 吃完饭后，安妮主动提出洗碗，但玛丽拉怀疑地问她是否能洗干净。

paragraphs.en: Anne was assigned to wash the dishes, a task she performed efficiently under Marilla’s watchful eye. Later, attempting to make her bed with a feather tick, Anne struggled but managed to smooth it down. Relieved of this chore, Marilla allowed her to go outside until dinner.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮被分配洗碗，这项任务在玛丽拉的监督下她完成得相当高效。稍后，她试图用羽毛床垫整理床铺，但过程有些吃力，最终还是勉强平展了被子。完成了这项任务，玛丽拉便让她出去，在晚餐前可以自由活动。

paragraphs.en: Excited and eager, Anne rushed to the door only to stop abruptly, turn around, and sit back at the table. Her initial excitement seemed extinguished as she sat there silently.
paragraphs.zh: 兴奋不已的安妮冲到门口，突然又停了下来，转过身坐在桌旁。她原本的热情似乎瞬间消散，静静地坐着没有说话。

paragraphs.en: "Is something wrong?" Marilla asked sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “出什么事了？”玛丽拉严肃地问道。

paragraphs.en: Anne hesitated before stepping out of Green Gables. She felt torn between her love for the place and the fear of being forced to leave. "If I can’t stay here," she said, "there’s no point in loving Green Gables.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮站在绿山墙的门口犹豫不决，心中充满了矛盾。她既爱着这个地方，又害怕被迫离开。“如果我不能留在这里，”她说，“那就没什么意义去爱绿山墙了。”

paragraphs.en: And if I get to know all these trees and flowers, it will only make leaving harder." Anne sighed, knowing that staying inside was better than risking her newfound contentment.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我能熟悉这些树木和花朵，离别时一定会更加难舍。”安妮叹了口气，心里明白待在屋内比冒风险失去这份新得的满足感要好得多。

paragraphs.en: "Is there a name for the geranium on the window-sill?" she asked, looking at Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: “窗台上那盆万寿菊叫什么名字？”她看着玛丽拉问道。

paragraphs.en: "That’s the apple-scented geranium," replied Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: “这就是那种苹果香味的天竺葵。”玛丽拉回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I meant to give it a personal name. Can I call it Bonny while I’m here? Please let me!"
paragraphs.zh: “哦，我想给它起个名字。我可以在这里叫它‘美丽’吗？求求你了！”

paragraphs.en: Marilla shrugged, unbothered by the request. "Why bother naming a geranium?"
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉耸了耸肩，对这个请求毫不在意。“何必给一盆万年青起个名字呢？”

paragraphs.en: Anne insisted, reasoning that names made things feel more like people. She had already named the cherry tree outside her bedroom window, calling it Snow Queen because of its white blossoms. Even though it wouldn’t always be in bloom, she could still imagine it as such.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚持这么认为，她觉得名字能让事物显得更像人。她已经给卧室窗外的樱桃树取了个名字——雪女王，因为它的白花让她联想到白雪皇后。尽管它不会永远处于开花状态，但她依然可以把它想象成那样。

paragraphs.en: Marilla returned from the cellar, muttering about Anne's unusual presence. "I've never seen or heard anything like her," she said. "She’s kind of interesting, as Matthew says.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉从地窖里回来，嘴里嘟囔着关于安妮不寻常的出现。“我从来没见过也没听过像她这样的人。”她说，“她有点儿有趣，就像马修说的那样。”

paragraphs.en: I can already feel myself wondering what she'll say next."
paragraphs.zh: 我已经开始猜测她接下来会说什么了。

paragraphs.en: Anne had drifted into a reverie, staring at the sky with her chin in her hands. Marilla left her alone until dinner was ready.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮陷入沉思，双手托着下巴凝视着天空。直到晚餐准备妥当，玛丽拉才让她独自一人。

paragraphs.en: "Can I have the mare and buggy this afternoon, Matthew?" asked Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: “马修，我今天下午能用一下母马和双轮马车吗？”玛丽拉问道。

paragraphs.en: Matthew nodded but looked wistfully at Anne. Marilla saw his look and said grimly, "I'm going to drive over to White Sands and settle this matter. I'll take Anne with me, and Mrs. Spencer will probably send her back to Nova Scotia soon.
paragraphs.zh: 马修点了点头，但目光中流露出一丝渴望，望向安妮。玛丽拉看到了他的眼神，语气坚决地说：“我要开车去白沙滩那边处理这件事。我会带上安妮一起去，雷切尔·林德夫人可能会很快把她送回诺瓦斯科舍。”

paragraphs.en: I’ll set your tea out for you and be home in time to milk the cows."
paragraphs.zh: “我去给你准备茶点，等会儿赶回来挤牛奶。”

paragraphs.en: Matthew remained silent, leaving Marilla feeling frustrated. She thought nothing was more aggravating than a man who wouldn't talk.
paragraphs.zh: 马修沉默不语，这让玛丽拉感到十分烦躁。她觉得一个不愿意说话的男人是最让人头疼的。

paragraphs.en: After Matthew hitched the sorrel into the buggy, Marilla and Anne set off. As they drove slowly through the yard gate, Matthew said to no one in particular, "Little Jerry Buote from the Creek came by this morning, and I told him I'd hire him for the summer."
paragraphs.zh: 马修把红棕色的马套进马车后，玛丽拉和安妮出发了。当她们缓缓驾车穿过院子的大门时，马修自言自语道：“克里奇的小杰瑞·布欧特今天早上过来找我了，我说这夏天我会雇用他。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla gave the sorrel a vicious clip with the whip, causing the mare to gallop down the lane at an alarming pace. Marilla glanced back and saw Matthew leaning over the gate, looking wistfully after them.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉用力地用鞭子抽了一下栗色马，那匹mare飞快地在小路上疾驰起来。玛丽拉回头一看，只见马修倚在门口，满怀羡慕地望着她们的背影。
